description: Polyphonic truth table: four gate inputs pick one of sixteen cells, and that cell's state becomes the output

inputs.text: Read as the ones bit of the cell number, a voltage above 1V counting as a one
Read as the twos bit of the cell number, a voltage above 1V counting as a one
Read as the fours bit of the cell number, a voltage above 1V counting as a one
Read as the eights bit of the cell number, a voltage above 1V counting as a one
Sets all sixteen cells, one channel per cell, a channel above 1V turning that cell on; the cells follow this input while a cable is patched

outputs.text: Carries 10V when the picked cell is on and 0V when it is off, with as many channels as the widest of the four gate inputs

notes: all sixteen cells come up switched off, so the output stays at 0V until cells are clicked on, the module is randomised, or the TF input sets them
clicking a cell in the grid toggles it, and randomising the module gives every cell an even chance of being on
